hero.name: Thibaud Masurel
hero.description: I design and build modern, performant, and elegant web applications.

about.title: About
about.description: A passionate software development student, I specialize in building complete web applications — from Go back-ends to modern React interfaces. Every project is an opportunity to sharpen my skills and tackle new technical challenges.
about.description2: My journey has led me to work on diverse problems: graph algorithms, REST APIs, real-time systems with WebSockets, and front-end development with frameworks like Next.js. I place great emphasis on code quality, performance, and user experience.
about.description3: Curious and self-taught, I'm also interested in the DevOps ecosystem (Docker, CI/CD), software architecture, and development best practices. My goal: building elegant solutions that solve real problems.

groupie-tracker.title: Groupie Tracker
groupie-tracker.description: Interactive Music Data Visualizer. Transformation of complex raw data into a fluid UI. Features high-performance dynamic filtering and optimized data relationship handling.

ascii-art-web.title: ASCII Art Web
ascii-art-web.description: Terminal Art on the Web. Instant text-to-ASCII conversion service, bridging low-level string manipulation with modern web architecture.

lem-in.title: Lem-in
lem-in.description: Critical Data Flow Optimization. Engineered an intelligent algorithm capable of efficiently routing thousands of units through complex networks in record time.

make-your-game.title: Make Your Game
make-your-game.description: High-Performance Game Engine. Retro arcade experience built from scratch in Vanilla JS/Canvas. Component-based architecture ensuring constant 60 FPS without frameworks.

teamup-hub.title: TeamUp Hub
teamup-hub.description: Management platform providing instant visibility into member activity and statistics. Event-driven WebSocket architecture for immediate synchronization of critical data.
